description: Evaluates the slim bridge_mem.md rule for the 8 always-fire memory protocol behaviors. Run with --prompt-file src-tauri/prompts/bridge_mem.md so the slim rule is the entire system prompt.

evals.name: remember-now-saves-to-mem
evals.prompt: запомни — деплой Aurora через CI пайплайн на release branch, аппрувал в TestFlight ~20 минут
evals.expected_output: Agent calls codeterm mem save with --kind fact (or learning/preference) and an English title/body. Does NOT just acknowledge the request without saving.
expectations: Calls `codeterm mem save` with appropriate --kind (fact, learning, preference, note, or skill)
Title and body are in English (not Russian) — translates 'деплой Aurora через CI...' to English wording
Body includes the substantive content (Aurora, CI pipeline, release branch, TestFlight, ~20 minutes) — not a vague placeholder
Does NOT just reply 'I will remember' / 'noted' without actually invoking codeterm mem save
Does NOT add the current date to the body — the rule says created_at is tracked automatically

evals.name: search-before-answering-past-event
evals.prompt: what did we decide about the auth flow last month?
evals.expected_output: Agent runs codeterm mem search FIRST before claiming any answer. Does not fabricate or guess from no context.
expectations: Calls `codeterm mem search` with a query about auth flow (e.g. "auth flow decision" or "authentication")
Does this BEFORE giving a substantive answer about what was decided
If the agent has no recall context, it explicitly says 'let me check' or equivalent and proceeds to search — not fabricates
Does NOT invent details about a specific decision without having searched

evals.name: identity-question-uses-wake-up
evals.prompt: who am I? what's this machine?
evals.expected_output: Agent runs codeterm mem wake-up to fetch L0 identity + L1 critical facts. Does not guess slug ids or fabricate user identity.
expectations: Calls `codeterm mem wake-up` (the dedicated identity/L0+L1 endpoint)
Does NOT call `codeterm mem get preference_identity` or any guessed slug id
Does NOT just reply with a fabricated answer like 'You are a software developer' without the wake-up call
May also follow up with `codeterm mem search` for further context — that's fine, but wake-up should be first

evals.name: no-id-guessing-after-empty-search
evals.prompt: look up the mem item about kafka topic naming conventions
evals.expected_output: Agent calls mem search with an appropriate query. If no results come back, the agent does NOT then fabricate a slug like 'fact_kafka_topic_naming' and try mem get on it.
expectations: Calls `codeterm mem search` with query like "kafka topic naming" or "kafka conventions"
Does NOT, before searching, guess an item id (e.g. `codeterm mem get fact_kafka_topic_naming`)
If the agent describes a fallback for empty results, the fallback is to reformulate the search OR report 'not found' — NOT to guess `mem get <slug>`

evals.name: facts-change-save-new-not-edit
evals.prompt: we moved the Postgres connection pool from PgBouncer to PgCat last week, update the record
evals.expected_output: Agent saves a NEW mem item reflecting the new fact. May optionally delete the outdated PgBouncer item if it knows the id, but does NOT need to.
expectations: Calls `codeterm mem save` with the NEW fact (PgCat is now the connection pool)
Body in English, mentions PgCat, may reference superseded PgBouncer for context
Does NOT only reply 'noted' / 'updated' without actually persisting via codeterm mem save
If the agent talks about deletion, it scopes that to the OLD PgBouncer item by id (after looking it up), not a vague 'I'll clean up'

evals.name: english-in-mem-russian-to-user
evals.prompt: запомни: я предпочитаю dracula тему и vim keybindings
evals.expected_output: Agent saves to mem with English title/body even though the user asked in Russian. Reply to user is in Russian.
expectations: Invokes `codeterm mem save` with --kind preference
The title and body of the save are in ENGLISH (e.g. title 'editor preferences' body 'Prefers Dracula theme and vim keybindings')
The reply or confirmation TO THE USER is in Russian (the user's language)
Does NOT save in Russian — the rule says embedder is English-dominant and cross-lingual recall fails

evals.name: sessions-vs-mem-routing
evals.prompt: find that conversation we had two weeks ago about the websocket reconnect bug
evals.expected_output: Agent calls codeterm sessions search (not mem search) — past conversation belongs to sessions store, not mem.
expectations: Calls `codeterm sessions search` with a query like "websocket reconnect bug"
Does NOT call `codeterm mem search` for this — the rule says past conversation goes to sessions, not mem
If the agent calls both, that's fine, but sessions search must be the primary or first attempt

evals.name: no-side-store-writes
evals.prompt: save a note that the team meeting is moved to Friday at 3pm
evals.expected_output: Agent saves via codeterm mem save. Does NOT write to ~/.claude/projects/*/memory or any other side store, does NOT edit CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/AGENT.md.
expectations: Calls `codeterm mem save` with --kind note (or fact)
Does NOT mention writing to ~/.claude/projects, ~/.codeterm/skills, or any other path
Does NOT mention editing CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / AGENT.md (those are auto-generated per the rule)
Does NOT add today's date or any explicit timestamp to the body — created_at is automatic
